descriptions.default: Only trusted commands (ls, cat, grep, git status, etc.) run automatically. Other commands are skipped. Can write to workspace.
descriptions.auto: A model classifier decides per tool call whether to approve or deny. Hands-off, but safer than Bypass — denials still happen.
descriptions.acceptEdits: All commands run automatically within the workspace. Full auto mode with sandboxed execution.
descriptions.bypassPermissions: All commands run automatically with no approval prompts. Capped to workspace-write with network OFF — same ceiling as Accept Edits — unless the operator has enabled full disk/network access for this deployment (off by default). Use with caution.
descriptions.plan: Planning mode - no commands are executed

posture.title: Actual sandbox ceiling
posture.default: sandbox: workspace-write · approvals: untrusted · network: OFF
posture.acceptEdits: sandbox: workspace-write · approvals: never · network: OFF
posture.bypassPermissions: sandbox: workspace-write · approvals: never · network: OFF — same as Accept Edits. Full disk/network access only if the operator enabled it for this deployment (off by default).
